The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:
This role is needed to deliver HelixOS Migration work for Venmo :
Venmo’s risk decisioning runs on a legacy stack that is costly to change and not aligned with PayPal’s shared risk architecture. Helix OS is the unified risk platform. Venmo must onboard to it to keep real-time fraud, credit, and abuse controls on one consistent, scalable, auditable foundation.
This job delivers complete solutions across the SDLC for the Venmo Risk Platform, powering real-time fraud and risk decisioning for millions of Venmo users. Design and build low-latency, highly available services .Partner with Risk Strategy, Data Science, and Product to turn risk and policy into reliable, auditable platform capabilities

Job Description: Cloud/DevOps Engineer

We manage Venmo’s infrastructure comprehensively, encompassing operations, automation, security, compliance, and release engineering. While we are focused on Cloud Engineering, our work integrates elements of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and DevOps projects as well. Job Summary:
Join AI Growth & Innovation, where you take emerging AI from zero to N - building and enhancing agentic systems, real-time voice, and multimodal experiences directly in production with real customers. As a Senior Staff Engineer, you'll turn ambiguous problems and emerging tech into a point of view, then prototype fast to prove or disprove hypotheses and scale what works into reliable, secure products. You'll own high-visibility bets end-to-end, from research through production. Day to day: research new models and frameworks, launch experiments with safe-rollout practices, track metrics like quality, latency, cost, and impact, and extend our agent platform's orchestration, tool use, and evaluation. You will be someone who moves beyond established playbooks, builds scrappy prototypes to test reality fast, and partners with product, design, and engineering to turn validated ideas into platform capabilities.
Job Description:
Essential Responsibilities:
Makes technical decisions affecting multiple teams, crossing organizational boundaries
Establishes conventions & processes to be followed by other employees
Actions determine the utilization of company resources (people, money, assets) and affect the effectiveness of the company
Handles multiple, multi-team initiatives simultaneously, using judgement to prioritize among more issues than can be handled individually.
Understands evolving industry capabilities & practices and can judiciously apply up--to-date information for optimal results
Competent at communicating technical issues with non-technical audiences
Spreads their behavior, principles, and knowledge as a means of improving technical results of other employees (via many means – modeling behavior, 1:1s, working sessions, quality documentation)
Partners with product management, to ideate solutions to business problems & goals
Minimum Qualifications:
8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications :
Required Qualifications
Senior or staff-level engineering experience, with impact beyond your own code
A track record of shipping to real users and scaling early ideas into reliable, secure, cost-efficient products
Hands-on experience building with LLMs or agentic systems, at work, in a startup, or on serious independent projects
A bias toward fast, scrappy prototyping: given an ambiguous problem, you'd rather build a rough version and test it against reality than debate it on paper first
Comfort with ambiguity and strong research instincts: you learn fast, design quick experiments to prove or disprove a hypothesis, and apply what you learn without waiting for a settled playbook
Drive and ownership: you take on stretch problems, go beyond your scope, and follow through until it ships
Strong engineering fundamentals in at least one modern language
Clear communication with engineers and executives
Preferred Qualifications
Real-time voice or multimodal experience
Automated evaluation and observability for AI systems
Deep knowledge on model fine-tuning, trade-offs, and when to use it
